budget_items.topic: Lunenburg FY16 net school spending over foundation budget
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Net school spending in FY16 is reported as a dollar amount and as a percentage over the foundation budget.
budget_items.quote: in fy16 lunenburg's net school spending was $3,583,931 or 23.4% over the foundation budget.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Mr. Abrahams said at full equity Lunenburg would receive about $275,000 more in Chapter 70 aid than this year.
budget_items.quote: later noted that at full equity lunenburg would receive about $275,000 more dollars in chapter 70 aid than it will receive this year.

budget_items.topic: Cost of raising the state foundation budget
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Mr. Abrahams said a Foundation Budget Review Commission increase would raise the local contribution by about $480 million statewide.

budget_items.topic: Local contribution and foundation budget discussion
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Greg said the Town already funds its school budget well above the foundation budget, so a higher foundation budget would not raise its local contribution.
budget_items.quote: greg observed that if the foundation budget increased the town would not pay any higher local contribution as we are already funding a school budget 23% higher the foundation budget.
